digest.component_or_area: pytest test fixtures and macOS CI teardown
propositions: Shared pytest basetemp cleanup fails on macOS when snapshot-producing tests in any module leave read-only .rebar/run_snapshots trees because cleanup was owned only by a module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py

Production snapshot publication intentionally applies 0444/0555 permissions via snapshot._chmod_readonly, making residual cache roots non-removable by ordinary shutil.rmtree unless permissions are restored

The fix moves the snapshot teardown rule from tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py into tests/conftest.py as an autouse fixture that searches each test-owned tmp_path for exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots and applies snapshot._rmtree_writable
Production snapshot permissions and read-only behavior during test execution remain unchanged; only post-test cleanup is moved to shared lifecycle
Adjacent temporary content outside .rebar/run_snapshots is untouched by the shared teardown fixture

Cross-module snapshot producers (e.g. in test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py) now have their read-only cache roots properly cleaned via the centralized fixture instead of leaving non-removable basetemp residuals
